Stopped out doesn't mean wrong.

Tuesday in the NY session I shorted 1 ES at 7,187.00 and my 4 point hard stop sat at 7,191.00. Price tagged it and the stop filled half a point worse, at 7,191.50. -4.5 points.

Right after, I went short again from 7,187.50, same stop distance. This time price rolled over. I moved the stop down twice, first to 7,182.00 and then to 7,177.50, and closed at 7,172.50.

+15 points on the second short, -4.5 on the first. Net +10.5 points.

The idea wasn't wrong. The first entry was early. Sometimes you just need a re-entry with the same defined risk.

After a stop-out, do you re-enter, wait for a new setup, or call it a day?
